+import pytest
+from tinyshop.reports import best_seller
+from tinyshop.db import connect, add_product, find_products, record_sale, sales_for_day
+

+def db(tmp_path):
+    conn = connect(tmp_path / 'test.db')
+    yield conn
+    conn.close()
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def products(db):
+    add_product(db, 'Product A', 10.0)
+    add_product(db, 'Product B', 20.0)
+    add_product(db, 'Product C', 30.0)
+    return find_products(db, 'Product')
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def sales(db, products):
+    product_id = products[0][0]
+    record_sale(db, product_id, 10, '2023-01-01')
+    record_sale(db, product_id, 20, '2023-01-02')
+    record_sale(db, product_id, 30, '2023-01-03')
+    return sales_for_day(db, '2023-01-01')
+
+def test_best_seller__a0(db, products, sales):
+    assert best_seller(db, '2023-01-01') == 'Product A'
+
+def test_best_seller__a1(db, products, sales):
+    assert best_seller(db, '2023-01-02') == 'Product A'
+
+def test_best_seller__a2(db, products, sales):
+    assert best_seller(db, '2023-01-03') == 'Product A'
+
+def test_best_seller__a3(db, products, sales):
+    assert best_seller(db, '2023-01-04') is None
